name: 07438 · Oak Ridge, NJ
findings: ZIP 07438 (Oak Ridge) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07438 (Oak Ridge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07438 (Oak Ridge) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
